text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
One-two, one-two,
spin around and...
There!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Club Kid A
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Big sis, you're amazing!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Club Kid B
text_block_list.text: So cooool~!

Today, at the request of a certain Umamusume Club,
I am teaching dance to some young Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The steps and choreo matter, but...
the most important thing of all is your heart!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Let's dance with all our heart to say,
"Thank you for supporting us!", okay?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Phew! Worked up a good sweat!
choice_data_list: Good work. How did it go?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Everyone is so earnest and quick to learn...!
Dancing really does call for a smile, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
They're all such good girls...
............

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe.
I was just remembering the old days a little.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm an alumna of this club—
the "Victory Club."
Victory Club. An Umamusume training club where kids can begin race training from a young age.
Famous for its positive and bright atmosphere, it was also notable for gathering many girls who carried the "Sakura" name.
choice_data_list: And that brings us to this request...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...How nostalgic.
Just like those kids, I used to
learn dancing from an older girl...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It was so beautiful, so cool, and it made my heart race.
...And I thought to myself,
I want to practice hard at dancing too...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to dance like that,
in a way that brings smiles to everyone's faces.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Did I do as well as
that girl did back then?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding,
I got a little sentimental there!
Ehehe...
choice_data_list: The past really connects to the present, doesn't it?
The past really connects to the present, doesn't it?
Why not take a look at the girls around you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding,
I got a little sentimental there!
Ehehe...
choice_data_list: The past really connects to the present, doesn't it?
The past really connects to the present, doesn't it?
Why not take a look at the girls around you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ! I see...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I wonder if that cool older girl felt the same way I did.
choice_data_list: And today's children pass it on to the next...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I see! Dancing is—wait, no!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Races, songs... everything!
Maybe that's just how everything
connects together.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Club Kid A
text_block_list.text:
Big sis Chiyono O!
Teach me some more dancing, pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay!
I'm coming right now~!

The dance was passed down from the older generation to the younger ones.
I watched over them with a warm feeling in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Our surroundings...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Club Kid A
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Big sis's dance was way more
exciting and fun!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Club Kid B
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then!
Let's try doing that twirl even faster!
Just like Big Sis Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: Looks like you're shining properly out there.
Looks like you're really shining out there, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, what a surprise.
I guess I really am a big sister after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll do my best! I've gotta show everyone an even more sparkling side of me!
